name: NexGen Virtual Office
summary: Virtual workplace for remote and hybrid teams: individual offices on an interactive floor plan, instant face-to-face video, in-platform chat and a whiteboard, priced per user for teams of 1 to 100 with a separate enterprise offer.
best_for: small and mid-sized remote or hybrid teams, up to 100 people, who want a visual virtual office with drop-in video and chat instead of scheduling every conversation
skip_if: your team already lives in a chat and video tool and only needs meetings, or you want to read documentation and policies before you buy
honest_knock: There is very little public documentation: no help centre, no setup guide and no published refund or cancellation rules beyond 'cancel anytime' on the monthly plan. We found no current free trial. Enterprise pricing is only available after a demo, and the product runs under several names and domains (NexGen Technologies, NexGen Virtual Office, NexGen Virtual Workplace), which makes it harder to check what you are buying.

pricing.entry_price_terms: SMB Monthly · per user, paid monthly, for 1 to 100 employees with self implementation
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-27 on nexgenvirtualworkplace.net, SMB Market page; the Enterprise and Webex pages were read on 2026-10-20; dollar amounts, the page does not name the currency) NexGen prices its virtual workplace per user for companies with 1 to 100 employees, all with self implementation: $25 per user paid monthly (cancel anytime), $20 per user a month paid quarterly ($60 per quarter) or $15 per user a month paid yearly ($180 per year). Enterprise customers, which the page describes as 1,000 or more seats, have to book a demo; no price is published. NexGen separately resells Webex 3.0 bundles, from Basic at $49.95 a year (meetings up to 40 minutes and 100 attendees) to Meet at $14.95 a month or $144 a year per seat. We found no current free trial: the free offer on the homepage referred to September 2026.
